description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock service via AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method declarations for various API operations related to the Bedrock agents, such as creating, deleting, and updating agents and associated resources.

classes.name: BedrockAgentClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon Bedrock agents, extending the generic AwsClient and providing specific methods for interacting with the Bedrock agent API.

methods.name: associateAgentCollaborator
methods.description: Associates a collaborator with an agent.

methods.name: associateAgentKnowledgeBase
methods.description: Associates a knowledge base with an agent.

methods.name: createAgentActionGroup
methods.description: Creates a new agent action group.

methods.name: createAgentAlias
methods.description: Creates a new alias for an agent.

methods.name: createFlowVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a flow.

methods.name: createPromptVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a prompt.

methods.name: deleteAgentVersion
methods.description: Deletes a specific version of an agent.

methods.name: deleteFlowVersion
methods.description: Deletes a specific version of a flow.

methods.name: deleteKnowledgeBaseDocuments
methods.description: Deletes documents from a knowledge base.

methods.name: disassociateAgentCollaborator
methods.description: Removes a collaborator from an agent.

methods.name: disassociateAgentKnowledgeBase
methods.description: Removes a knowledge base association from an agent.

methods.name: getAgentActionGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details about an agent action group.

methods.name: getAgentAlias
methods.description: Retrieves details about an agent alias.

methods.name: getAgentCollaborator
methods.description: Retrieves details about an agent collaborator.

methods.name: getAgentKnowledgeBase
methods.description: Retrieves details about an agent's knowledge base.

methods.name: getAgentVersion
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific agent version.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Retrieves details about a data source.

methods.name: getFlowAlias
methods.description: Retrieves details about a flow alias.

methods.name: getFlowVersion
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific flow version.

methods.name: getIngestionJob
methods.description: Retrieves details about an ingestion job.

methods.name: getKnowledgeBase
methods.description: Retrieves details about a knowledge base.

methods.name: getKnowledgeBaseDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves documents from a knowledge base.

methods.name: ingestKnowledgeBaseDocuments
methods.description: Ingests documents into a knowledge base.

methods.name: listAgentKnowledgeBases
methods.description: Lists knowledge bases associated with agents.

methods.name: listFlowVersions
methods.description: Lists different versions of a flow.

methods.name: listKnowledgeBaseDocuments
methods.description: Lists documents within a knowledge base.

methods.name: updateAgentKnowledgeBase
methods.description: Updates an agent's knowledge base association.
